scripts.deploy: npm run backup && vite build && if [ ! -f dist/index.html ] || grep -qE '<script[^>]*src=' dist/index.html; then echo 'ERROR: build not inlined (no dist/index.html, or an external <script src=> remains). Aborting before touching the Pi.'; exit 1; fi && ssh pi@$HESTIA 'sudo rm -rf /home/pi/scripts/oneui/* && mkdir -p /tmp/oneui-deploy' && scp -r dist/* pi@$HESTIA:/tmp/oneui-deploy/ && ssh pi@$HESTIA 'sudo cp -r /tmp/oneui-deploy/. /home/pi/scripts/oneui/ && rm -rf /tmp/oneui-deploy && sudo killall -TERM surf'
scripts.backup: ssh pi@$HESTIA 'DATE=$(date +%-m-%-d-%y) && sudo mkdir -p /home/pi/backups/$DATE && sudo tar czf /home/pi/backups/$DATE/oneui.backup.tar.gz /home/pi/scripts/oneui && ls -l /home/pi/scripts/oneui | sudo tee /home/pi/backups/$DATE/js-builds.txt >/dev/null && echo UI backup OK'
scripts.rollback: ssh pi@$HESTIA 'sudo tar xzf /home/pi/backups/$(date +%-m-%-d-%y)/oneui.backup.tar.gz -C / && sudo killall -TERM kweb && echo UI rollback complete'
